newsitem.title: USA: Suiza to buy Fleming's dairy unit.
newsitem.headline: Suiza to buy Fleming's dairy unit.

text.p: Suiza Foods Corp said Wednesday it has purchased the assets of the Nashville, Tennessee dairy division of Fleming Companies Inc for an undisclosed price.
Suiza will operate the dairy as Country Delite Farms. Country Delite Farms is a processor of milk and related dairy products and had sales of approximately $76 million in its 1996 fiscal year.
Suiza said it anticipated the acquistion will be slightly accretive to 1997 earnings and will provide an increasing contribution in the coming years.
The company said the Country Delite acquisition provides it with an entry into the Tennessee market and an enhanced presence in the southeastern United States.
